description: GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/events/stream and GET /v1/sessions/{session_id}/threads/{thread_id}/stream are server-sent-event streams (the official SDKs consume them as `Stream<...>`; https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/sessions-events-stream), but the spec declares their 200 response as `application/json` with the per-event schema. Replace the content type with `text/event-stream` so the converter emits them as stream operations whose output is one event.
